reason: This file is obsolete. Rev 1 of the design declared one effect name per pad slot here and forbade duplicate effects. Both were wrong: Resolume auto-suffixes duplicates (goo/goo2/goo3) so they ARE addressable, and a hand-edited file is the wrong contract for a live rig.
replacement: Effects are now discovered at runtime from the Resolume webserver API and driven by numeric parameter id over the WebSocket. See DESIGN.md section 4. The only FX file is config/fx_pins.csv, which TouchDesigner WRITES to remember pad positions across restarts. No human edits it.
